name: fr.vraisdeals/deals
title: VraisDeals – bons plans Amazon.fr vérifiés
description: Live Amazon.fr deals for France, verified against own price history.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search current Amazon.fr deals verified by VraisDeals against its own price history (FR). Use when someone asks for deals, discounts or the best price for a product or category on Amazon.fr. Returns price with price_updated_at, discount, price_check (lowest/good/normal/high), confidence, a reason and the deal page.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Is this a good price right now? Price check for any product on Amazon.fr by name or ASIN – also without a current deal – from VraisDeals's own price measurements: latest price, price_check (lowest/good/normal/high), confidence and a reason in fr.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List VraisDeals deal categories with URLs.
